verdict.rationale: Databricks' own docs describe managed and built-in system.ai MCP services, governed in Unity Catalog. They also explicitly cover connecting external clients such as Claude, Cursor and MCP Inspector to MCP servers hosted on Databricks, and a probe confirms the official MCP documentation page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of external agents connecting, and detail on which tools the managed servers expose and how client authentication is set up.
